name: Arturo Schomburg
summary: Arturo Alfonso Schomburg (January 24, 1874 – June 10, 1938), was a Puerto Rican historian, writer, curator, and activist, who wrote numerous books. Schomburg was a Puerto Rican of African and German descent. He moved to the United States in 1891, settling in New York City (at the age of 17) where he researched and raised awareness of the contributions that Afro-Latin Americans and African Americans have made to society.
